title_zh: 选择病房探视时带的卡片

scenario.label_zh: 选择病房探视时带的卡片
scenario.goal_zh: 核对病人已提出的探视偏好并约定带卡片并在病房外会合

context_zh: 虚构健康沟通练习。两位朋友准备探视刚做完肿瘤手术的共同朋友，讨论的是病人自己提出的探视需求。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: Have you heard what Dev would like us to bring to the ward?

sentences.speaker: Neil
sentences.text: A card, mainly. After the tumor operation, he said he'd prefer a short, quiet visit.

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: Then I won't bring the whole group. Has he asked for anything else?

sentences.speaker: Neil
sentences.text: No, just the card. Your idea of getting everyone to sign it is thoughtful.

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: I'll bring that, then. Shall we meet outside the ward at two?

sentences.speaker: Neil
sentences.text: Yes. We can check with the desk before going in.
